question: Based on the SQD transactions we've indexed, a graph of the wallets that transact with each other, transferring SQD around, in the same window

definitions.SQD: The SQD token at 0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1 on Arbitrum and 0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78 on Base, as in answers/sqd-net-accumulators
definitions.same window: October 2026, from 2026-10-01 00:00 UTC up to 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC, as in answers/sqd-net-accumulators
definitions.wallet: Any address that sent or received SQD, contracts included. The zero address is left out, since mints come from it and burns go to it; they are not transfers between wallets
definitions.transact with each other: An edge from A to B when A sent B at least one SQD Transfer in the window. Edges are directed and add up both chains; each edge keeps its transfer count and SQD amount per chain. A transfer from an address to itself is no edge

alternatives: Undirected edges, joining A to B and B to A into one pair
Only pairs that sent SQD both ways
Keep mints and burns as edges from and to the zero address
One graph per chain instead of one for both

results.sql:
-- How many edges the SQD transfer graph has over October 2026 on Arbitrum and Base: pairs of addresses
-- where the first sent the second SQD. sqd_transfer_graph_by_edge lists them.
select count(*) as edges
from (
    select distinct from_address, to_address
    from "warehouse"."analytics"."erc20_transfers"
    where (
        (
            chain = 'arbitrum'
            and token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
            and block_number between 510496864 and 520129273
        ) or (
            chain = 'base'
            and token = '0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78'
            and block_number between 52011727 and 53350926
        )
    )
    and from_address <> to_address
    and '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' not in (from_address, to_address)
) as edges

-- The edges of the SQD transfer graph over October 2026 on Arbitrum and Base: one row per sender and
-- recipient, with the transfers and SQD that went from one to the other, per chain and in total, most SQD
-- first. Transfers to self, mints and burns are left out. The blocks and tokens are those of
-- answers/sqd-transfer-graph/question.yaml.
with sqd as (
    select chain, from_address, to_address, value
    from "warehouse"."analytics"."erc20_transfers"
    where (
        (
            chain = 'arbitrum'
            and token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
            and block_number between 510496864 and 520129273
        ) or (
            chain = 'base'
            and token = '0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78'
            and block_number between 52011727 and 53350926
        )
    )
    and from_address <> to_address
    and '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' not in (from_address, to_address)
)

select
    from_address,
    to_address,
    round(sum(value) / 1e18, 6) as sqd,
    count(*) as transfers,
    round(coalesce(sum(value) filter (where chain = 'arbitrum'), 0) / 1e18, 6) as arbitrum_sqd,
    count(*) filter (where chain = 'arbitrum') as arbitrum_transfers,
    round(coalesce(sum(value) filter (where chain = 'base'), 0) / 1e18, 6) as base_sqd,
    count(*) filter (where chain = 'base') as base_transfers
from sqd
group by from_address, to_address
order by sum(value) desc, from_address, to_address

-- The nodes of the SQD transfer graph over October 2026 on Arbitrum and Base: each address with how many
-- addresses it sent SQD to and got SQD from, and the SQD on those edges, most SQD moved first. The same
-- transfers as sqd_transfer_graph_by_edge.
with sqd as (
    select from_address, to_address, value
    from "warehouse"."analytics"."erc20_transfers"
    where (
        (
            chain = 'arbitrum'
            and token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
            and block_number between 510496864 and 520129273
        ) or (
            chain = 'base'
            and token = '0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78'
            and block_number between 52011727 and 53350926
        )
    )
    and from_address <> to_address
    and '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' not in (from_address, to_address)
),

sides as (
    select from_address as address, to_address as other, 'out' as direction, value from sqd
    union all
    select to_address as address, from_address as other, 'in' as direction, value from sqd
)

select
    address,
    count(distinct other) filter (where direction = 'out') as sent_to,
    count(distinct other) filter (where direction = 'in') as received_from,
    round(coalesce(sum(value) filter (where direction = 'out'), 0) / 1e18, 6) as sqd_sent,
    round(coalesce(sum(value) filter (where direction = 'in'), 0) / 1e18, 6) as sqd_received,
    round((coalesce(sum(value) filter (where direction = 'in'), 0) - coalesce(sum(value) filter (where direction = 'out'), 0)) / 1e18, 6) as net_sqd
from sides
group by address
order by sum(value) desc, address
